Requirement Performance by Codecs.description: Performance and efficiency is a key quality attribute of Apache Lucene to support fast searching. Understanding how codecs contribute to the efficiency of retrieval in Apache Lucene will provide insight into how Apache Lucene supports performance. You are tasked with exploring the architectural decisions in the Codecs components that enable Performance in Apache Lucene.
